tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a product to the shopping cart by its product id. Quantity may be fractional for items sold by weight (kg). The shopper must be logged in.

product_id.description: Product id, as returned by search_products.

tools.name: duplicate_order
tools.description: Repeat a past order by adding all of its products to the cart. Omit order_id to repeat the most recent order. By default this replaces the current cart; set keep_current_cart to true to merge instead.

order_id.description: The order to repeat. If omitted, the most recent order is used.

keep_current_cart.description: Keep existing cart items and merge (true) instead of replacing them (false, default).

tools.name: list_recent_orders
tools.description: List the logged-in shopper's recent orders (id, date, item count, total), most recent first.

limit.description: How many orders to return (1-20). Defaults to 5.

tools.name: remove_from_cart
tools.description: Remove a line item from the cart using its cart_id. Call view_cart first to obtain the cart_id.

cart_id.description: The cart line id, as returned by view_cart.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the Farmerim grocery catalog by name (Hebrew or English) and return matching products with their ids.

tools.name: view_cart
tools.description: List the items currently in the shopping cart, with quantities and prices.
